messages:
emily.docs: opened a PR to fix the API ref for function/tool-calling. current docs show `functions: {name: string, spec: string}` as a single object and the response example shows `tool_call: {name, output}`. runtime actually expects `tools: [{name, spec}]` (array) and returns `tool_calls: [{name, output, duration_ms}]` (array). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1723

ryan.eng: thanks  did that make it into published pages? can you paste broken vs corrected curl + a staging response so i can smoke test?

emily.docs: broken (live site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","input":"Call the tool","functions":{"name":"lookup","spec":"..."}}'
```
fixed (canonical):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","inputs":["Call the tool"],"tools":[{"name":"lookup","spec":"..."}],"call_tools":true}'
```
staging response sample (what we'll include in docs):
```json
{"model_id":"redwood/gpt-3x","tool_calls":[{"name":"lookup","output":"Found: item 123","duration_ms":42}],"choices":[{"text":"Result: Found: item 123"}],"request_id":"req_tool_001"}
```

josh.sdk: our JS helper used `functions` singular in examples and the SDK return object was showing `tool_call` singular; we have compatibility mapping but docs should be canonical. i'll update the SDK snippets to show `tools: [{...}]` request and handle `tool_calls` array in responses (sdk PR 211). will include a one-liner: "SDKs will accept legacy `functions` but prefer `tools`."

carla.prod: please add a short migration blurb at the top of the endpoint page: "Tool/Function calling: switch from `functions` (object) -> `tools` (array). Response now contains `tool_calls: []`. This change clarifies multi-tool flows." CS should get a heads-up. i'll add it to release notes under "API reference: tool-calling fix".

link-bot: docs/link-check failed in docs/pull/1723  broken anchor to /sdk/js#tool-calling-examples.

ryan.eng: ran the canonical curl on staging  200 OK, response matched the sample above. i'll paste the exact staging output into the PR as the approved example. once link fix and sdk snippet PR land, i'm ok to merge after one more smoke test.

emily.docs: thanks all  tracking: docs PR 1723 (request/response schema + examples), sdk PR 211 (snippets + compat note), fix for broken anchor. will update PR with staging response and merge once link-bot is green.
